+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

+function runCases(cases: [string, string][], label: string) {
+  for (const [input, expected] of cases) {
+    it(`${label} "${input}" -> "${expected}"`, () => {
+      expect(transliterateThai(input)).toBe(expected);
+    });
+  }
